title: Human-approved common benchmark and planning-option integration
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's instruction to proceed with the next prioritized OpenFS work. Define one machine-checkable common benchmark campaign for all six EEA1 applications, connect its outputs and explicit commitment boundaries to all three published system planning options, expose the provisional plan on GitHub Pages, and add consistency checks. Keep all completion counts evidence-backed, all scores unset, procurement use prohibited, and Consensus incomplete. Validate, push, and create a bilingual reviewable pull request. Do not merge or deploy production GitHub Pages without a separate explicit instruction.
